title: Metabolism
description: A cell is a chemical network: hundreds of enzymes in chains and cycles, each feeding the next. Unlocks the Fermenter.

puzzle.goal: A chain of n enzymes each passes on a share f of what it is given. A amount of sugar goes in; write the amount Y that reaches the end.
puzzle.name: Pathway yield
puzzle.ask: Find Y for A = @{A}, f = @{f} and n = @{n}.
puzzle.method: Each step multiplies by f, so n steps multiply by fⁿ: long pathways need very good enzymes.
